text.zh: {{t:trichoptera}}来自希腊文 thrix（毛）加 pteron（翅），意思是「有毛的翅」。
text.en: {{t:trichoptera}} comes from the Greek thrix (hair) and pteron (wing): 'hairy-winged'.
text.ms: {{t:trichoptera}} berasal daripada bahasa Yunani thrix (rambut) dan pteron (sayap): 'bersayap berbulu'.

text.en: Think 'hair': hairy wings, not scaly ones.

items.zh: 两对多毛的膜质翅，看起来像蛾
items.en: Two pairs of hairy membranous wings; looks like a moth
items.ms: Dua pasang sayap bermembran berbulu; kelihatan seperti kupu-kupu

items.zh: 停下时翅呈屋脊状盖在身上
items.en: Wings held tent-like over the body at rest
items.ms: Sayap seperti khemah di atas badan ketika berehat

items.zh: 触角细长如线，常比身体长
items.en: Long thread-like antennae, often longer than the body
items.ms: Sesungut panjang seperti benang, sering lebih panjang daripada badan

v.zh: 完全变态（卵→幼虫→蛹→成虫）

items.zh: 溪流附近的石蛾，常被灯光吸引
items.en: Caddisflies near streams, often drawn to lights
items.ms: Lalat kadis berhampiran sungai, sering tertarik kepada cahaya
